Title: Free CAD Software
Description:
There are many free Computer Aided Design (CAD) programs out there for FTC teams to use. You can use these softwares to create 3D models.

Beginner:
Autodesk TinkerCAD - Free (Web)

Intermediate:
PTC Onshape - Free for FIRST Teams (Web, iOS, iPadOS, Android)
Audodesk Fusion 360 - Free for FIRST Teams (Windows, MacOS, Web)
FreeCAD - Free (Windows, MacOS, Linux)

Advanced:
Dessault Systems Solidworks - Free for FIRST Teams (Windows)
Autodesk Inventor - Free for FIRST Teams (Windows)
PTC Creo - Free for FIRST Teams (Windows)

Title: Robot Sign Template
Description:
Every team is required to have a BLUE and RED Robot Sign for their robot. This tells the referees which robot is on which alliance.

This is a template that can be printed out. A sign printed on paper is not the only way to create your robot sign. Please read the robot construction rules in the competition manual for robot sign requirements.

Title: Engineering Portfolio Examples
Description:
Each of these examples came from the website ftcportfoliolab.org. This is a website where teams can upload their portfolios from various seasons. You can filter the portfolios by season and by what awards they won. Please mind that the engineering portfolios you will see on this site are from teams in much larger regions than our own. Use these for inspiration and don't feel discouraged by all the content they have. Many of these teams have existed for half a decade or more.

Title: Port Pinouts
Description: This PDF will show you what each port on the REV Control System is used for and help you correctly connect motors, sensors, and other hardware when building your robot.

Title: Getting Started with the Driver Hub
Description: This website is your main guide for setting up and using your Driver Hub.

Title: Configuring robot with the Drive Hub
Description: This website will show you how to configure your robot's motors, servos, and sensors in the Driver Hub so they can be used in your code.

Title: Status LED Blink Codes
Description: This website will help you understand the LED blink codes on your Control Hub, Expansion Hub, and Driver Hub so you can identify problems and know what steps to take to fix them.

Title: Control Hub Troubleshooting
Description: This website will help you fix common Control Hub issues, including connection problems, error lights, software updates, and communication between the Driver Hub and Control Hub.

Title: Driver Hub Troubleshooting
Description: This website will help you solve common Driver Hub problems, such as updating the software, fixing startup issues, and troubleshooting connection or charging problems.

Title: REV Hardware Client
Description: This website provides the software you must install on your computer to set up your robot. Use this tool to manage, update, and fix your robot's electronics throughout the season.

Title: Navigating the REV Hardware Client
Description: This PDF is a guide that explains how to use the REV Hardware Client to manage your robot's parts. It provides a breakdown of the software's three main tabs—Hardware, Downloads, and About—so you know how to connect your devices and perform software updates.

Title: Troubleshooting the REV Hardware Client
Description: This document explains how to fix issues if the REV Hardware Client doesn't detect your robot's parts.
